en: JJWXC support ships as a private component; behaviour is unchanged
One shared wait / message / toast surface with inline confirms
Scalable CJK font covers 8105 standard characters
16-level text and anti-aliased UI icons and lines
Text settings no longer freeze and gain a 1-bit/16-level preview
Band refresh and local ghost cleanup across the UI
This release needs a full install: the language pack changed
zh: 晋江支持改为私有组件，功能与 0.2.3 一致
统一等待 / 消息 / Toast 表面，确认框全部内联
可缩放中文字体覆盖 8105 个通用规范汉字
正文 16 级灰度，UI 图标与线条抗锯齿
文字设置不再卡死，新增 1 位 / 16 级预览
全界面列带刷新与局部残影清理
语言包有变化，本次需要完整安装
